landing.demo_banner: Prototype / Demo Portal • Built for Karur City Municipal Corporation • AI Civic Grievance System
landing.civic_tagline: Spot it. Report it. Track it.
landing.ticker_news: Latest: Karur City Municipal Corporation AI Civic Redressal Portal is live • Instant automated classification for Roads, Water Supply, and Streetlights • Average resolution within municipal SLA hours • Contact: 04323 222 951
landing.hero_title: Report Civic Issues. Build a Better Karur.
landing.hero_subtitle: Spot a pothole, leaking water main, or broken streetlight? Snap a photo and let our AI computer vision detect, assess severity, and dispatch the municipal crew immediately.
landing.tile_report_desc: Snap a photo & submit with GPS in 30 seconds
landing.tile_feed_desc: Support local issues & view verified reports
landing.stats_subtitle: Real-time grievance registration, departmental action, and resolution metrics in Karur
landing.how_subtitle: A transparent 4-step workflow powered by AI computer vision from reporting to on-site resolution
landing.step1_desc: Citizen uploads a photo of the defect. AI computer vision immediately verifies the issue and filters invalid images.
landing.step2_desc: Computer vision assesses damage area ratio and crack count to automatically assign High, Medium, or Low severity.
landing.step3_desc: Grievance is routed directly to concurrent municipal department engineers with an active SLA countdown timer.
landing.step4_desc: Municipal crew repairs the defect on-site and must upload verified completion proof photos before closing.
landing.what_subtitle: Civic Guardian is specialized for 3 critical municipal infrastructure domains
landing.cat_roads_desc: Potholes, asphalt damage, road surface craters, and asphalt cave-ins.
landing.cat_water_desc: Pipeline bursts, potable water leakages, drainage overflows, and clogged lines.
landing.cat_elec_desc: Non-functional luminaires, dark stretches, loose cables, and utility pole hazards.
landing.recent_subtitle: Recent civic grievances reported by citizens across Karur wards
landing.about_p1: Karur is an ancient city of heritage and vibrant textile industry situated along the banks of the Amaravathi and Cauvery rivers. The Karur City Municipal Corporation is committed to delivering modern, responsive, and accountable civic services to all residents.
landing.about_p2: The AI Civic Guardian platform bridges citizens and municipal engineers, eliminating bureaucratic delays and ensuring that civic grievances are acknowledged and resolved transparently.
landing.helpline_subtitle: Reach Karur Municipal Administration directly for civic emergencies and inquiries
landing.office_address: Thiruvalluvar Play Ground Complex, Azad Road, Karur, Tamil Nadu - 639001
landing.working_hours: Working Hours: Monday to Saturday: 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM
landing.footer_rights: Content owned and maintained by Karur City Municipal Corporation • Government of Tamil Nadu
landing.footer_desc: Civic Guardian is an AI-powered municipal grievance redressal system.
